description: Source code for a fixed regulator driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing enable/disable, voltage listing, and initialization functions.

methods.name: regulator_fixed_enable
methods.description: Enables the fixed regulator by setting GPIO high.

methods.name: regulator_fixed_disable
methods.description: Disables the fixed regulator by setting GPIO low.

methods.name: regulator_fixed_count_voltages
methods.description: Returns the number of available voltages (fixed at 1).

methods.name: regulator_fixed_list_voltage
methods.description: Lists the voltage for a given index (only index 0 supported).

methods.name: regulator_fixed_init
methods.description: Initializes the regulator device, configuring GPIO if needed.
